Coram : ANIL R. DAVE*, KURIAN JOSEPH, SHIVA KIRTI SINGH, ADARSH KUMAR GOEL, R.F. NARIMAN
1018 l A PANKAJAKSHI (DEAD) THROUGH LRS. & OTHERS B c D E F G H v. CHANDRIKA & OTHERS (Civil Appeal No. 20 I of2005) FEBRUARY 25, 2016 [ANIL R. DAVE, KURIAN JOSEPH, SHIVA KIRTI SINGH, ADARSH KUMAR GOEL AND R.F. NARIMAN, JJ.) Travancore-Cochin High Court Act, 1125 - s. 23 - Kera/a High 1125 Act - Provision of s. 23, nature vis-a-vis s. 98(2) CPC - Held: s. 23 of the 1125 Act remains unaffected by the repealing provision of s. 9 of the Kera/a High Court Act - Section 23 being in the nature <if special provision vis-a-vis s. 98(2) Cl'C, would apply to the Kera/a High Court -
Decision Date : 25-02-2016 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 201/2005 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 5 Judges
